gaps: field-goal and try outcomes are drawn from the published nfl_pbp rates (2022-2025, weeks 1-18): each draw is a labelled sample, not the result of a real game
blocked kicks and returned misses are not modelled: a missed kick gives the other team the spot of the kick
timeouts, penalties, onside kicks, overtime and the exception coin-toss paths are not modelled, and each is listed in unsupported_rules
two-minute warning crossings are marked at the actual post-down clock, but clock running/stopped state and explicit clock restart transitions remain unsupported and are listed in unsupported_rules
participants are the players on the observed plays each simulated play was sampled from: they are labelled as sampled, and they are not this game's roster, lineup or substitutions

clock_start_stop.guard: numeric runoff and two-minute crossing markers are recorded, but the rules-required clock running/stopped state and explicit restart transitions are not modelled

lineups.guard: participants are labelled sampled_observed_play; no lineup or substitution is modelled

missed_field_goal_return.guard: Rule 11-4-2 exceptions (1) and (2): when the receivers touch a missed field goal beyond the line of scrimmage, the general scrimmage-kick rules apply instead of the spot of the kick. The table records makes and misses, not touches, so every missed field goal here is awarded at missed_field_goal_spot

onside_kicks.guard: every kickoff is drawn from the observed kickoff pool; no onside kick is drawn

overtime.enforced_by: record status; the game is not complete
overtime.guard: a tie after regulation blocks the game as overtime_not_modelled

penalties.enforced_by: E1 pool exclusion, counted in the pool exclusions
penalties.guard: no penalty is drawn: E1 excludes penalty plays from its pool (classify: penalty, not modelled)

timeouts.guard: no timeout is drawn: the published table has no timeout fields. A sampled play flagged with a timeout charges one of the three per half to the side it names, if that side has one left (_apply_timeouts); the stoppage is inside the observed runoff, and the rule itself is not checked against the rulebook

provisional_rules.applies_to: a touchdown, made field goal or safety whose clock expires in Q1 or Q3
provisional_rules.effect: the scoring side (or the conceding side, after a safety) kicks off at the start of the next quarter
provisional_rules.label: provisional_practice_rule
provisional_rules.source: NFL practice, not written in docs/rules/NFL-2026-GAME-STATE-RULES.md. Confirm against the 2026 rulebook before it is read as a rules-file fact.

provisional_rules.applies_to: a score whose clock expires in Q2
provisional_rules.effect: no post-score kickoff; the second-half kickoff from the ledger follows
provisional_rules.label: provisional_practice_rule
provisional_rules.source: NFL practice, not written in docs/rules/NFL-2026-GAME-STATE-RULES.md. Confirm against the 2026 rulebook before it is read as a rules-file fact.

provisional_rules.applies_to: a kickoff whose runoff exhausts the clock
provisional_rules.effect: the quarter ends on the return; the receiver starts the next quarter at the kick spot
provisional_rules.label: authored_modelling_choice
provisional_rules.source: authored modelling choice, matching E1 clamping a play runoff at 0:00; not in the rules file
